blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte before the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague is set to begin on Nov. 30, 2026, making him the first former Asian head of state to stand trial before the tribunal. The 81-year-old former leader will face trial 20 months after his arrest on three counts of crimes against humanity, involving murder and attempted murder linked to his administration’s so-called war on drugs.
